# webDG release dependencies (generated by tools/build_release.py)
#
# Normal use: double-click start.cmd -- it creates .venv and installs these.
# Manual:     .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt \
#                 --proxy http://127.0.0.1:7897 --index-url https://pypi.org/simple
#
# NOTE: keep this file pure ASCII. When requirements.txt has no BOM, pip decodes
#   it with the system locale encoding (cp936 on Chinese Windows), so a single
#   UTF-8 non-ASCII comment aborts the whole install with UnicodeDecodeError.
#   Explanatory notes therefore have to be written in ASCII here.

# These are NOT optional -- a clean install breaks without them:
#   eclipse-zenoh  the message bus; every node imports it (bottom layer, TF)
#   pyserial       the ESP32 coyote host's serial link; sim_coyote dies without it (T1)
#   sherpa-onnx    speech recognition engine. The models ship inside this release, so
#                  without the engine you get "models but no engine" and the node
#                  silently degrades to volume-only detection (T6)
#
# Not listed below: dglab-kit-python (the official Coyote V4 SDK) is not on PyPI;
# its source ships inside this release at vendor/dglab-kit-python and start.cmd
# installs it from there.
#
eclipse-zenoh>=1.10.1

mediapipe>=1.0.1
opencv-python>=4.9

pygrabber
